items.name: SpanContext
items.summary: Immutable portion of a [`Span`] which can be serialized and propagated.

methods.name: empty_context
methods.summary: Create an invalid empty span context

methods.name: is_remote
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the span context was propagated from a remote parent.

methods.name: is_sampled
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the `sampled` trace flag is set.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the span context has a valid (non-zero) `trace_id` and a valid (non-zero) `span_id`.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(trace_id: TraceId, span_id: SpanId, trace_flags: TraceFlags, is_remote: bool, trace_state: TraceState) -> Self

methods.name: trace_state
methods.summary: A reference to the span context's [`TraceState`].

items.name: TraceState
items.summary: TraceState carries system-specific configuration data, represented as a list of key-value pairs. TraceState allows multiple tracing systems to participate in the same trace.

methods.name: delete
methods.signature: fn delete<K: Into<String>>(&self, key: K) -> Result<TraceState, TraceStateError>
methods.summary: Removes the given key-value pair from the `TraceState`. If the key is invalid per the [W3 Spec] an `Err` is returned. Else, a new `TraceState` with the removed entry is returned.

methods.name: from_key_value
methods.signature: fn from_key_value<T, K, V>(trace_state: T) -> Result<Self, TraceStateError> where T: IntoIterator<Item = (K, V)>, K: ToString, V: ToString
methods.summary: Creates a new `TraceState` from the given key-value collection.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Retrieves a value for a given key from the `TraceState` if it exists.

methods.name: header
methods.summary: Creates a new `TraceState` header string, delimiting each key and value with a `=` and each entry with a `,`.

methods.name: header_delimited
methods.summary: Creates a new `TraceState` header string, with the given key/value delimiter and entry delimiter.

methods.name: insert
methods.signature: fn insert<K, V>(&self, key: K, value: V) -> Result<TraceState, TraceStateError> where K: Into<String>, V: Into<String>
